page.description.en: Every Org Topologies term in one place: the map, the four intelligences, topologies, MADE, Elevating Katas and AI, defined as in the book 10X ORG.
page.description.text: Alle Org Topologies-begreber samlet ét sted: kortet, de fire intelligenser, topologier, MADE, Elevating Katas og AI, defineret som i bogen 10X ORG.

terms.lead.en: Grouped as you meet them: the foundations, the map, the topologies, MADE, the nine principles, the katas and AI. Link to any term with its anchor.
terms.lead.text: Grupperet i den rækkefølge, du møder dem: fundamentet, kortet, topologierne, MADE, de ni principper, katas og AI. Link til ethvert begreb med dets anker.

top.lead.en: One shared language is half the work of org design. Every Org Topologies term, defined as in the book *10X ORG*.
top.lead.text: Ét fælles sprog er halvdelen af arbejdet med organisationsdesign. Alle Org Topologies-begreber, defineret som i bogen *10X ORG*.
